author: jimbozard
quote: Peak-woke Rockstar product. Lucia is pure girlboss fanfic, dialogue is sterile and safe, and the once-legendary edge is completely sanded off. Most of the “satire” just punches right while treating leftist degeneracy with kid gloves. Map looks pretty and the sandbox still works, but the soul is gone. Thirteen years and a billion dollars for this corporate, politically neutered slop.
